1329-2921-3363.easyPrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2921-3363.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing The One Ring, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

1661-4478-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2044-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

3678-3899-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3240-5477-6462-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Insidious Roots triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

622-757-1543-5087.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
622-757-1543-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Ichormoon Gauntlet to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Kamahl, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

2608-4499-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Halflings.
2608-4499-7908.description:
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat.

1017-2122-4565.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Ozolith, the Shattered Spire
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Rukarumel, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-2034-4452.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

3177-3259-3861--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3177-3259-3861--85--106.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

250-779-1479-2783-4693.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2783-4693.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

628-2366-2584-6931.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
628-2366-2584-6931.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters, Tourach's Chant and Pandemonium trigger.
Resolve the Tourach's Chant trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Dryad Arbor.
Dryad Arbor dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Dryad Arbor enters, Tourach's Chant and Pandemonium trigger.
Resolve the Tourach's Chant trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, dealing damage to Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 4.

3661-5220-5315-6900.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2228-3108-5361.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Auton Soldier.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Auton Soldier by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1680-3767-3918-5116.description:
Activate Trazyn using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2060-3398-4120-6758.notablePrerequisites:
Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
Hellkite Charger cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2060-3398-4120-6758.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering it and Dawnsire.
Resolve the Dawnsire trigger, attempting to deal 100 damage to Crystalline Crawler, which will result in 100 +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability seven times by removing seven +1/+1 counters from it, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2060-3398-4120-6758.notes: As long as Crystalline Crawler has enough +1/+1 counters on it, you do not need to target it in step 1, allowing you to put +1/+1 counters on other creatures you control if desired.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

413-4550-5042-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
413-4550-5042-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

1329-1778-2178-5256.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-5256.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2608-4605-5921.notablePrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
You control up to six permanents that can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
2608-4605-5921.description:
Activate up to six permanents by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger twice.
Resolve both Derevi triggers, untapping up to two permanents.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Derevi that is a 0/1 Illusion creature token.
Put the nontoken Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and choose to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When the Derevi token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping up to two permanents.
Resolve the second Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Derevi that is a 0/1 Illusion creature token.
Put either Derevi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Derevi token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping up to two permanents.
Activate up to six permanents by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Put the remaining Derevi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

2060-2313-3574-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mikaeus.
2060-2313-3574-4222.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-2313-3574-4222.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

144-628-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, as well as its undying ability if it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the second trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from steps 1 and 5, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

851-3398-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have a full party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos and Hellkite Charger.
851-3398-4076.description:
Declare Burakos and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating eight Treasure artifact tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

225-1636-1776.notablePrerequisites:
Spawning Grounds attached to any Forest you control.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1636-1776.description:
Activate the land with Spawning Grounds attached by tapping it, creating a 5/5 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land with Spawning Grounds attached.
Repeat.

2698-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2698-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
The creature dies, triggering Vogar's first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1000-2104-2493-2727.notablePrerequisites: {1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Mystic Reflection was foretold.
1000-2104-2493-2727.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Archaeomancer.
Cast From Under the Floorboards by paying {3}{B}{B}, creating three token copies of Archaeomancer and gaining 3 life.
Each of the Archaeomancer's ETBs trigger, returning Mystic Reflection, Temporal Manipulation, and From Under the Floorboards to your hand.
Repeat.

364-1309-1987-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
364-1309-1987-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
